Conditional on U_i=t, the remaining coordinates are (1-t)V, so their joint upper-bound probability is nondecreasing in t. The opposing indicator is nonincreasing, giving the covariance sign and then the product bound by induction on the original law.

The actual cap thresholds give c_i/(1-c_j)<=1/d. For d>=2, the binomial and logarithm bounds give 1/2<=alpha_d<2/3. The sequence k alpha_d^(k-1) is decreasing from k=2 onward and its k=2 value dominates k=1.

Two centroid-coordinate constraints leave an interior point and each imposed section has exactly one marginal cutoff. In d=1 both midpoint constraints would force zero length. The closed half interval attains the counting bound.

Inclusion–exclusion on equal levels uses a remaining mass factor 1-ell c/(1-c), with a null intersection at zero. Recomputed the equal-centroid inclusion–exclusion and bounds by exact rational arithmetic for dimensions 2–30. Original §§1–3 are matched, and the separate source-tilt quota is outside this proposition.
